Not vendored (size): TensorFlow.js (about 1.5 MB), MobileNet model, Bangla and English language data (tessdata). The language data is downloaded once from the URL in the owner setting and then kept in the browser cache.
ML Kit is a native Android SDK and is not in this folder: see docs/ANDROID_WRAPPER.md.
